method: OpenAI image generation, original game assets

files.role: Distant environment matte painting; foreground gameplay is rendered in 3D

direction: Original dark fantasy and future technology; midnight navy, violet, antique gold, cyan rim light; mature heroic proportions, polished comic illustration. Knight: closed angular helm, cyan visor, gold layered armor, violet cape, shield and energy sword. Gargoyle: blue-gray stone, horns, cyan fissures and violet bat wings. Witch: silver hair, armored violet clothing, gold crescent halo and crystal staff. Environment: floating gothic citadels over violet mist with gold windows and cyan conduits.
references: Temple Run informs movement readability; Marvel Snap informs illustration finish and color hierarchy. No franchise characters, logos, assets, screenshots or card UI are copied.
